channel.title: Saurav Pandey - Engineering Notes & Research
channel.description: Technical writings, systems research, and software reflections by Saurav Pandey (Programming Assistant in Avionics at HAL, MCA student).

item.title: Why I Built an E-Commerce Backend in Pure Java Servlets
item.description: Why avoiding Spring Boot for a college project was the best decision I made for learning HTTP lifecycles, multithreaded servlet concurrency, and pure JDBC thread safety.

item.title: Decentralized State: What I Learned Building on the Internet Computer
item.description: How WebAssembly canisters work, why users do not pay gas fees via the reverse gas model, and hosting frontend code completely on-chain.

item.title: Lightweight Symmetric Bitwise Ciphers for Resource-Constrained Embedded Controllers
item.description: Investigating trade-offs between computational overhead, RAM consumption, and entropy dispersion in lightweight circular-rotation XOR cipher blocks for low-memory microcontrollers.

item.title: Playing with Bitwise Math and Binary Files in C++
item.description: Streaming bytes with std::fstream, fixed-size chunk buffers, and why opening files in binary mode prevents newline corruption on Windows.

item.title: Orthogonal Persistence vs Gas-Metered EVM: Architectural Analysis of the Internet Computer
item.description: Comparative analysis of WebAssembly orthogonal memory persistence versus Ethereum Virtual Machine gas metering and state trie architectures.
